model.description: The name of the model (override default in runner settings).

system_prompt.description: The system prompt to use for the system output. (override the default system prompt)

options.description: The options to use for the model.

context.description: An encoding of the conversation used in this response, this can be sent in the next request to keep a conversational memory

max_tokens.description: The length of the sample to generate (in tokens) (default: context size).

temperature.description: The temperature used to generate samples.

repeat_penalty.description: Penalty to be applied for repeating tokens, 1. means no penalty.

repeat_last_n.description: The context size to consider for the repeat penalty.

seed.description: The seed to use when generating random samples.

extract_reasoning_content.description: Extract reasoning content from the response. When reasoning_effort is unset, false also requests no thinking (same as reasoning_effort=none).

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning (thinking) intensity: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or a token budget number (e.g. "2048"). Takes precedence over extract_reasoning_content.

chat_template_kwargs.description: JSON object string sent as chat_template_kwargs to OpenAI-compatible local servers, e.g. '{"enable_thinking": false}'. Ignored by the Ollama runner.
